name: fqc-lessons
description: Knowledge / learning loop for FQC-ARR over the JSONL lessons store (data/lessons/*.jsonl + _stable.jsonl). Reads ground every role's prompt with cited lessons; writes (record/promote/archive/reflect) keep the store as the single source of truth. Also indexed as a Sana knowledge collection for retrieval.

securityScheme.note: Sana-managed; writes limited to the agent's own knowledge collection.

tools.name: load_for
tools.description: Return the stable + recent lessons relevant to a role, formatted for prompt grounding (mirrors format_lessons_for_prompt). Read-only.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Semantic/keyword search over the lessons store (e.g. by model name + symptom) for the debugger and implementer. Read-only.

tools.name: record
tools.description: Append a new lesson (a miss/win/insight) to the working store. Not a governed external write; no HITL gate.

tools.name: promote
tools.description: Promote a validated working lesson into _stable.jsonl (survives reflection compaction).

tools.name: archive
tools.description: Archive a stale/incorrect lesson so it stops grounding prompts.

tools.name: reflect
tools.description: Run the twice-daily/weekly reflection+compaction (equivalent of --learn). Optionally triggered by a Sana scheduled trigger instead of launchd.
